name: Reeded Glass
description: A wide pane of reeded glass slides across the frame: behind its ribs the picture breaks into narrow, flipped slices with faint color fringes, and where it has passed the second clip is left clear. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: pane_width
params.description: Width of the pane, in frame widths

params.name: ribs
params.description: Number of ribs across the frame width

params.name: strength
params.description: How strongly each rib flips and squeezes the slice behind it

params.name: shine
params.description: Strength of the highlights, seams and shadow of the glass
